    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const TOTAL = __TOTAL__;
      // sticker in: slap down with a tilt
      const slap = (sel, at, rot = -3, from = {}) =>
        tl.fromTo(sel, { opacity: 0, scale: 1.6, rotation: rot * 4, ...from }, { opacity: 1, scale: 1, rotation: rot, x: 0, y: 0, duration: 0.32, ease: "back.out(2.2)" }, at);
      const peel = (sel, at) => tl.to(sel, { opacity: 0, scale: 0.85, y: 40, duration: 0.18, ease: "power2.in" }, at);
      const draw = (sel, at, d = 0.35) => tl.to(sel, { strokeDashoffset: 0, duration: d, ease: "power2.out" }, at);

      /* ---------- camera: hook close-up on the face, then punch-ins (origin on the subtitle band) ---------- */
      tl.fromTo("#cam", { scale: 1.2 }, { scale: 1.16, duration: 1.9, ease: "sine.out" }, 0);
      const Z = [[2.0, 1.04], [6.7, 1.07], [11.1, 1.1], [11.85, 1.02], [16.96, 1.07], [18.9, 1.0], [19.7, 1.08], [20.6, 1.02],
        [24.57, 1.0], [26.75, 1.06], [29.09, 1.1], [30.85, 1.02], [33.52, 1.0], [35.82, 1.06], [37.55, 1.02]];
      Z.forEach(([t, s]) => tl.to("#cam", { scale: s, duration: 0.38, ease: "back.out(1.4)" }, t));

      /* ---------- subtitle tape ---------- */
      const CW = __CAPWORDS__;
      CW.forEach(([sel, s, e]) => {
        const el = document.querySelector(sel);
        const bg = el.classList.contains("hl") ? "#6c4bff" : "#0b0b0b";
        const fg = el.classList.contains("hl") ? "#ffffff" : "#c8ff2e";
        tl.fromTo(sel, { backgroundColor: "rgba(11,11,11,0)", color: "#0b0b0b" }, { backgroundColor: bg, color: fg, duration: 0.06, ease: "none" }, s);
        tl.to(sel, { backgroundColor: "rgba(11,11,11,0)", color: "#0b0b0b", duration: 0.1 }, Math.max(s + 0.07, e));
      });
      document.querySelectorAll(".cap").forEach((c) =>
        tl.fromTo(c.children, { opacity: 0, y: 10 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.14, stagger: 0.025, ease: "power2.out" }, +c.dataset.start));

      /* ---------- G1 hook ---------- */
      slap("#h1", 2.0, -4);
      draw("#h-under-p", 2.25, 0.4);
      slap("#h2", 2.85, 5);
      tl.to(["#h1", "#h2", "#h-under"], { opacity: 0, y: -30, duration: 0.15 }, 3.3);

      /* ---------- G2 affiliate ---------- */
      slap("#a1", 4.2, -2);
      peel("#a1", 6.25);

      /* ---------- G3 receipt ---------- */
      tl.fromTo("#rc", { opacity: 0, y: -120, rotation: 0 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, rotation: 3, duration: 0.45, ease: "power3.out" }, 6.5);
      tl.set(".rl", { opacity: 0 }, 6.5);
      [["#l1", 6.7], ["#l2", 8.0], ["#l3", 8.64], ["#l4", 10.34], ["#l5", 10.8]].forEach(([l, t]) =>
        tl.fromTo(l, { opacity: 0, x: -20 }, { opacity: 1, x: 0, duration: 0.18 }, t));
      draw("#s1", 7.9, 0.25); draw("#s2", 8.55, 0.25); draw("#s3", 10.25, 0.25);
      slap("#why", 11.1, -6);
      tl.to(["#rc", "#why"], { opacity: 0, y: 40, duration: 0.18 }, 11.7);

      /* ---------- G5 problems ---------- */
      slap("#pb", 11.9, -2);
      tl.set(["#p1", "#p2", "#p3"], { opacity: 0 }, 11.9);
      [["#p1", "#x1", 12.44], ["#p2", "#x2", 13.62], ["#p3", "#x3", 15.78]].forEach(([r, x, t]) => {
        tl.fromTo(r, { opacity: 0, x: -40 }, { opacity: 1, x: 0, duration: 0.22, ease: "power3.out" }, t - 0.08);
        draw(x, t + 0.08, 0.28);
      });
      tl.to("#p3", { keyframes: [{ scale: 1.08 }, { scale: 1 }], duration: 0.3 }, 16.96);
      peel("#pb", 17.5);

      /* ---------- G6 brand ---------- */
      slap("#b-join", 18.9, -3, { x: -60 });
      slap("#b-main", 19.7, -3);
      slap("#b-mcn", 19.85, -12);
      draw("#b-ring-p", 19.75, 0.6);
      tl.to(["#b-join", "#b-main", "#b-mcn", "#b-ring"], { opacity: 0, scale: 0.9, duration: 0.18 }, 20.45);

      /* ---------- G7 benefits ---------- */
      slap("#bn", 20.65, 2);
      tl.set(["#k1", "#k2", "#k3"], { opacity: 0 }, 20.65);
      [["#k1", "#t1", 21.94], ["#k2", "#t2", 22.5], ["#k3", "#t3", 23.6]].forEach(([r, t, at]) => {
        tl.fromTo(r, { opacity: 0, x: 40 }, { opacity: 1, x: 0, duration: 0.22, ease: "power3.out" }, at - 0.08);
        draw(t, at + 0.06, 0.25);
      });
      peel("#bn", 24.4);

      /* ---------- G8 battery ---------- */
      slap("#bt-card", 24.65, -2);
      tl.set(["#bt1", "#bt2", "#bt3", "#bt-circle", "#bt-bolt"], { opacity: 0 }, 24.65);
      tl.fromTo("#bt-fill", { scaleX: 0.7, backgroundColor: "#c8ff2e" }, { scaleX: 0.1, backgroundColor: "#e5322b", duration: 2.1, ease: "power1.inOut" }, 25.3);
      [["#bt1", 25.45], ["#bt2", 25.83], ["#bt3", 26.75]].forEach(([t, at]) => slap(t, at, 3, { x: 30 }));
      tl.to(["#bt1", "#bt2", "#bt3"], { opacity: 0, x: 30, duration: 0.2, stagger: 0.05 }, 27.25);
      slap("#bt-circle", 27.3, -4);
      tl.fromTo("#bt-bolt", { opacity: 0, scale: 0.4 }, { opacity: 1, scale: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "back.out(3)" }, 28.2);
      tl.to("#bt-fill", { scaleX: 1, backgroundColor: "#c8ff2e", duration: 1.0, ease: "power3.out" }, 29.09);
      const pct = { v: 10 };
      const showPct = () => (document.querySelector("#bt-pct").textContent = Math.round(pct.v) + "%");
      tl.fromTo(pct, { v: 10 }, { v: 100, duration: 1.0, ease: "power3.out", onUpdate: showPct, onReverseComplete: showPct }, 29.09);
      peel("#bt-card", 30.55);

      /* ---------- G9 start dari bawah ---------- */
      slap("#up-card", 31.05, 2);
      slap("#up-dulu", 31.2, -5);
      draw("#up-p", 31.6, 1.4);
      tl.fromTo("#up-a", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.1 }, 32.95);
      tl.fromTo("#up-lbl", { opacity: 0, y: 20 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.25 }, 32.3);
      peel("#up-card", 33.35);

      /* ---------- G10 blueprint ---------- */
      tl.fromTo("#bp", { opacity: 0, y: 160, rotation: 8 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, rotation: -2, duration: 0.45, ease: "back.out(1.6)" }, 33.6);
      tl.set(["#q1", "#q2", "#q3"], { opacity: 0.35 }, 33.6);
      [["#q1", "#u1", 34.72], ["#q2", "#u2", 35.4], ["#q3", "#u3", 36.76]].forEach(([r, u, t]) => {
        tl.to(r, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.15 }, t - 0.05);
        draw(u, t, 0.25);
      });
      peel("#bp", 37.35);

      /* ---------- G11 CTA ---------- */
      tl.fromTo("#cta", { opacity: 0, y: 120, rotation: -6 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, rotation: -1.5, duration: 0.45, ease: "back.out(1.7)" }, 37.58);
      tl.fromTo("#cta-n", { scale: 0.6, opacity: 0 }, { scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: "back.out(2.5)" }, 37.72);
      tl.fromTo("#cta-btn", { scale: 0.6, opacity: 0 }, { scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: "back.out(2.5)" }, 37.8);
      tl.to("#cta-btn", { keyframes: [{ scale: 1.06 }, { scale: 1 }], duration: 0.5, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 38.6);
      tl.fromTo("#cta-sub", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.25 }, 37.85);

      tl.set({}, {}, TOTAL);
      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
